Keyboard
Right, Space
Next beat, as Page Down from a clicker
Left
Previous beat, as Page Up
Down, Up
Next slide, previous slide
12 then Enter
Jump to slide 12
F
Full screen
S
Speaker notes and timer, over the slide
W
Speaker notes and timer, in a second window
], [
Read on in long notes, go back
T
Restart the timer
U
Hide “Client holds” and the progress bar
Q
Post-processing off, for a slow laptop
H, Escape
Open this help, close it
